title: coccothrinax miraguama subsp. havanensis
intro: Coccothrinax miraguama subsp. havanensis, commonly known as the Cuban thatch palm, is a subspecies of palm tree native to Cuba. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments. The health benefits of Coccothrinax miraguama subsp. havanensis include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to treat wounds, reduce fever, and alleviate digestive issues, while its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, saponins, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
